title: Stop at a black line
summary: Drive until the colour sensor sees black.
what: The robot drives forward and stops the moment its colour sensor (port B) sees the black line.
why: Instead of guessing a distance, the robot watches the mat. It does not matter if it started a little early or late: it always stops at the line. Using a sensor to decide when to stop is called closed loop.
try: Make it faster by changing the speed to 60. Does it still stop on the line?
After it stops, add a move backward 5 cm so it lines up just before the line.
With Realism on Realistic, press ▶×5. Compare the end points with Drive a square.
